text: まいあさ　れんしゅうも　してるんだ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: してる is the shortened form of している, and here it says something is done regularly. してる = 'I do it as a habit'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ, the spoken form of のだ, adds 'you see', giving this as the reason behind what was just said. してるんだ = 'I do it, you see'.
